scope: read-only R09 source and native basket_glass migration audit; no IFF/helper/source changes

depth_ir_interpretation.texture: AlbedoMapBC3 at Effect byte offset 296; not AlphaMaskMap
depth_ir_interpretation.shadow_discard: guard AND alpha < ShadowAlphaZWriteCutOff (byte offset 272; default 0.9)
depth_ir_interpretation.r09_expected: All albedo mips alpha=10/255, so discard if runtime constants honor IoR=1
depth_ir_interpretation.limitation: Runtime constant buffer values and replay selection are not captured

specialized_candidate.depth_rule: Default: Albedo.a < AlphaCutOffForDepth(.9); Translucent: Albedo.a*Opacity(1) < cutoff. Neither depends on IoR.
specialized_candidate.native_vertex_format_compatible: 8/4/8 streams; POSITION UNORM16x4, UV SNORM16x2, tangent UINT10x3A2, packed weight UINT32 at stream2 offset4; source native specialized model uses same storage despite VS TEXCOORD0 float4
risks: All 15 shader/script payloads and complete Effect incl ResourceMapping must be copied; all absent in R09.
Use full specialized Material, not old ScriptParameter/Technique/Resource names.
CW culling differs from original NONE; verify front/back winding and holes faces without blanket override.
Specialized OnlyDepthDoubleSided/OnlyDepthCSM contain VS only and no explicit alpha-test PS; shadow silhouette can differ.
Presentation pass existence does not prove actual replay selection.
Single-target premultiplied output belongs with ONE/INVSRCALPHA; never change only Rucker blend factors.

color_shader_semantics.source: Direct parsing of DXIL bitcode from local outdoor native shader payloads
color_shader_semantics.Albedo_channels: RGBA; samples texture index held at Effect byte offset36
color_shader_semantics.RoughnessTexture_channel: R only; samples texture index held at Effect byte offset24
color_shader_semantics.default_and_presentation_output_rgb: Shader internally multiplies diffuse term by Albedo.a * approximately0.905 * Albedo.rgb, then adds specular/reflection lighting; texture must not be premultiplied again
color_shader_semantics.translucent_output: Same computed RGB and Albedo.a, then multiplies all RGBA by Opacity at byte offset16
color_shader_semantics.preview_limit: Standard alpha blend with neutral tint approximates transmission but not native specular/IBL terms
color_shader_semantics.parser_scope: Full bitstream validated. Function output uses decoded SSA operations; memory load/store/gep/alloca are recorded as raw operands. This is a targeted audit representation, not an official DXC disassembly.

script_audit.native_script_semantic_decoding: Not available; proprietary script instructions not reverse-engineered. No claim of absence of camera-dependent behavior.

findings: No confirmed illegal R09 DDS resource or newly enabled ZWrite in its visible color passes.
R09 native generic depth shaders read Albedo alpha and conditionally discard under OneOverIoR==1; AlphaMask=0 is not evidence of depth being forced opaque.
A complete native specialized basket_glass contract provides a concrete alternative with Presentation and alpha-only prepass decisions; runtime success remains unverified.
